views.title: Whole system · frontend / backend
views.description: Follow the running application from its browser surfaces through the API to shared rules, workers and storage. Select a block to open its modules and files.

nodes.label: Browser workspace
nodes.detail: React keeps Chat at home with Workflows, Sources and Connections as detail surfaces. UI adapters coordinate editing, input selection and presentation.

nodes.label: Express API
nodes.detail: The server mounts authenticated resource routes. Actor identity comes from the session; workspace membership and operation type are checked before protected routes.

nodes.label: AI provider adapters
nodes.detail: Sina uses a configured OpenAI-compatible gateway. MicroSina uses a pinned Foundry agent. Agent Builder has a separate model routing path.

nodes.label: Workflow rules & tools
nodes.detail: Shared commands preserve versions and run identity. Injected deterministic executors calculate from pinned inputs in both execution paths.

nodes.label: Background workers
nodes.detail: The API starts ingestion and durable workflow workers. Queued workflows survive the initiating tab; browser previews and guided sessions still execute in the browser.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.detail: Persists sessions, memberships, chats, revisioned libraries, source metadata/chunks, grants, jobs and computer task records.

nodes.label: Sources & connectors
nodes.detail: Acquire documents or external JSON before running. Retrieval selects permitted passages with source revision and citation identity.

nodes.label: Mkoro companion
nodes.detail: A personal outbound-polling worker delegates computer work to the user's configured Goose CLI. Its results are observations, not proof of platform workflow completion.

nodes.label: Private object storage
nodes.detail: Supabase Storage holds original document bytes. The API issues signed URLs; ingestion downloads originals for extraction.

notes: This view combines reviewed relationships at module level; it is not an observed runtime trace.
Archives and generated build output are outside the active application map.
Computation, human approval and server synchronization remain separate states.

views.title: Technology stack
views.description: The concrete technologies and package boundaries used by the current checkout. Installed dependencies do not prove every feature is configured or enabled.

nodes.label: React · Vite · TypeScript
nodes.detail: Vite builds the browser app; React renders the workspace. Jotai binds shared state; XYFlow powers the workflow canvas. Tailwind/Radix provide UI building blocks.

nodes.label: CopilotKit · AI SDK
nodes.detail: CopilotKit connects chat context and function actions to the server runtime. The separate Agent Lab loop uses AI SDK generateText and configured model routing.

nodes.label: Gateway · Foundry · Goose
nodes.detail: Sina gateway configuration, optional MicroSina Foundry agent, and the companion's own Goose provider are separate model configurations.

nodes.label: TypeScript contracts · Zod
nodes.detail: Domain types and generated schemas define saved workflows; shared Zod validators protect API shapes, access roles and runtime inputs.

nodes.label: Node.js · Express · Better Auth
nodes.detail: Express 5 serves API routes. Better Auth owns sessions. Pino logs accepted request IDs and outcomes. Middleware binds workspace authorization.

nodes.label: Drizzle · pg · PostgreSQL
nodes.detail: The pg pool and Drizzle access the same database. PostgreSQL stores jobs and records; vector columns support document similarity retrieval.

nodes.label: Portable TypeScript rules
nodes.detail: workflow-core and workflow-executors compute results without React or model-provider dependencies. Source and agent packages have distinct responsibilities.

nodes.label: pnpm · Playwright · node:test
nodes.detail: The workspace has direct unit/core tests, isolated database integration suites, browser tests and architecture checks. This explorer links tests without claiming they ran.

nodes.label: Supabase · extraction · embeddings
nodes.detail: Originals use private Supabase Storage. Extraction libraries and configured OCR/embedding providers feed source indexing; missing integrations remain unavailable.

notes: Technology names come from manifests and inspected source; no live-provider availability was tested.
The workspace package pin is authoritative for commands. No runtime or dependency upgrade is part of this explorer.

views.title: API communication & models
views.description: Where browser requests go, which operations execute work, and how model and persisted-data boundaries fit together.

nodes.label: Browser requests
nodes.detail: apiFetch adds the active workspace header, request ID and same-origin credentials. It does not grant authority to the browser's role or identity.

nodes.label: Session → workspace → action
nodes.detail: Protected /api routes validate the live session and current membership. Route policy classifies read, write or execute; resource checks still apply inside handlers.

nodes.label: /api/copilotkit · /agent-lab
nodes.detail: Chat streams through CopilotKit. Agent Lab calls the shared server agent loop. Both are execute operations with bounded request bodies.

nodes.label: Resource APIs
nodes.detail: /workflow-library saves revisioned portable bytes; /chat stores messages; /documents manages sources and search. These are distinct persistence and retrieval paths.

nodes.label: Execution APIs
nodes.detail: /workflow-runs queues an exact saved version. /http-source acquires external JSON. /agent-actions checks scoped operations. Executing a request is not the same as approving a result.

nodes.label: Model selection
nodes.detail: Sina reads OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL with a code default of gpt-4o and gateway settings. MicroSina uses MICROSINA_AGENT_VERSION in Foundry. Agent Lab model routing is separately selected.

nodes.label: Persisted data model
nodes.detail: Workspace libraries contain drafts, versions and recorded sessions/runs. workflow_run_jobs snapshots durable definitions. Chat, source metadata/chunks and grants have separate tables.

nodes.label: Separate worker credential path
nodes.detail: /api/mkoro-worker authenticates a revocable bearer token and rechecks membership. It is mounted outside browser session middleware and only exposes worker operations.

nodes.label: External JSON & source storage
nodes.detail: Server connectors acquire external data; signed URLs carry original file bytes. Provider-specific credentials stay in their configured server or companion context.

notes: Model names shown here are source configuration, not a claim about secrets or the model active in a deployed environment.
POST /documents/search is a read operation; HTTP method alone does not define authorization.
The generated OpenAPI client covers only a subset; handwritten clients remain part of the active API surface.

views.title: How AI chat connects
views.description: The model chooses from offered tools; adapters execute those tools through the owning rules and APIs. The chat UI also shows evidence, review cards and computer task progress.

nodes.label: Chat conversation
nodes.detail: useAssistant registers readable workspace context, actions and shared session UI. Saved threads preserve conversation history and chosen chat agent.

nodes.label: Sina / MicroSina
nodes.detail: CopilotKit forwards a turn to the selected server adapter. Responses may request registered function actions; provider availability does not expand permissions.

nodes.label: Browser tool adapters
nodes.detail: React hooks register workflow, session, retrieval, live-data, document-review and computer delegation actions. Tool results return through the chat turn.

nodes.label: Open a surface
nodes.detail: Resource registry maps workflow/source/connection targets to their existing detail views. Opening an existing run selects it rather than executing it again.

nodes.label: Workflow commands & review
nodes.detail: Draft proposals, saved versions and session actions go through workflow-core. Scoped grants can authorize matching operations; otherwise the adapter shows a review card.

nodes.label: Read source evidence
nodes.detail: Document search returns permitted passages with source revision and citation IDs. Worksheet tools explain recorded values; missing data stays visible.

nodes.label: Acquire live data
nodes.detail: Native source adapters handle public JSON calls, supported connectors and other offered tools. Workflow source responses are pinned before deterministic replay.

nodes.label: Delegate computer work
nodes.detail: A structured task binds to the saved chat, actor and personal worker. Status, one-action decisions and Stop remain in the conversation.

nodes.label: Calculate & record
nodes.detail: Shared executors produce outputs and provenance from pinned inputs. Chat sessions use the browser runtime; durable queue execution is a separate path.

notes: A model-generated request is not its own authorization. Current workspace access, grants and domain validation remain authoritative.
Computer screenshots stay out of chat storage and model context. Worker text is not proof of workflow success.
The source defines Sina's normal path and optional MicroSina. Live parity was not tested.

views.title: How work gets done
views.description: From a user request and source evidence to saved workflow definitions, execution, inspection and explicit review. Select a step to find its owning files.

nodes.label: 1 · Choose the work
nodes.detail: Start in Chat or open a workflow directly. Select the exact saved workflow or an executable template and the intended source records.

nodes.label: 2 · Acquire evidence
nodes.detail: Upload/parse a file or fetch a supported connector response. Record its source identity, revision and extraction; acquisition failures stay visible.

nodes.label: 3 · Edit & save a version
nodes.detail: Builder and agent adapters use shared draft/version commands. A version is an immutable graph snapshot; an explicit missing version fails.

nodes.label: 4 · Synchronize library
nodes.detail: Local edits queue a revision-aware save. A conflict pauses writes and asks for recovery; a calculated result is not proof of server save.

nodes.label: 5a · Guided / local run
nodes.detail: Chat and Run share session commands and browser execution. Source changes invalidate dependent results; Pause takes effect between block calls.

nodes.label: 5b · Durable run
nodes.detail: Queue a synchronized exact version through /workflow-runs. A server worker claims the job, computes with shared executors, then persists result/status.

nodes.label: 6 · Inspect the recorded result
nodes.detail: Open the exact run and inspect block output, evidence and warnings. History selection does not invoke execution; local and durable records retain their runtime limits.

nodes.label: 7 · Review & deliver
nodes.detail: Review gates and document interpretation annotations have their own rules. Output exports do not silently grant approval or invent missing evidence.

notes: The diagram shows alternative local and server execution paths; the UI does not automatically make every chat action a durable job.
A schedule block records trigger context; it does not install a recurring scheduler.
How-to examples below describe current capabilities, with links to the code that owns each step.

notes.summary: Assembles the active Express application and orders its access boundaries before resource routes.
reads: Request path, body, session cookie, origin and request ID
writes: Response status/body and structured request logs
rules: Auth and health routes mount before protected resource middleware.
The worker token router has its own credential boundary.
Agent request bodies have a scoped size limit.

notes.summary: Derives the actor from Better Auth, rechecks the session row, loads current membership and classifies operations as read, write or execute.
reads: Better Auth session, sessions table, workspace_members, method/path and origin
writes: Authorized request scope fields or a denied response
rules: Browser-provided identity or role does not grant access.
Case and trailing-slash variants use the same operation classification.
Document search POST is read; chat, durable enqueue and connector calls are execute.

notes.summary: Builds the live CopilotKit endpoint, repairs orphan tool-call history, and selects Sina or optional MicroSina from an allowlisted agent header.
reads: Server gateway settings, OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL, conversation messages and offered tools
writes: Streamed model response or explicit provider-unavailable error
rules: Sina's code default is gpt-4o; environment configuration can choose another model.
Provider selection follows shared execute authorization.
Unknown agents fail; unavailable provider configuration does not fabricate a reply.

notes.summary: Adapts MicroSina to an explicitly versioned Foundry agent and restricts each turn to supported offered tools.
reads: Azure project endpoint, server identity, numeric agent version, offered function tools
writes: Foundry request body and provider response stream through its adapter
rules: The browser cannot set remote tool servers or approval policy.
Public tool_search/call_tool is a separate server-controlled optional setting.
Missing or malformed configuration fails explicitly.

notes.summary: Gates the workspace using session and membership checks and retains already-mounted drafts during temporary verification failures.
reads: /api/session, /api/workspaces or guest workspace endpoint, current browser workspace context
writes: React access state and workspace activation/reload through scoped adapters
rules: An explicit denied session clears access.
A temporary timeout or server error hides/disables a verified tree rather than discarding drafts.
Server membership remains authoritative.

notes.summary: Adds workspace scope, same-origin credentials and a request ID to relative application API requests.
reads: Current workspace context and caller RequestInit
writes: HTTP request headers and fetch response
rules: Only application /api requests receive these additions.
The workspace header selects scope; the server must authorize it.

notes.summary: Composes the Chat-first workspace and its registered detail surfaces while keeping conversation state in the owning adapters.
reads: Workspace window/navigation atoms, resource registry and assistant hook
writes: Selected workspace detail surface and navigation UI state
rules: Primary items are Chat, Workflows, Sources and Connections.
Run history belongs within Workflows rather than a new primary product menu.

notes.summary: Connects the conversation UI to CopilotKit context and actions, source attachment, workflow sessions and surface navigation.
reads: Chat state, workflow library, selected sources, resource catalog and workspace context
writes: Registered readable context/actions and user-driven UI state through adapters
rules: WorkflowSessionPanel and session-store commands are shared with the Run surface.
Individual tool adapters and domain commands own the operation rules.

notes.summary: Offers saved-workflow listing, reading, draft proposals and version saves as chat actions with authorization and review cards.
reads: Workflow library, complete proposed draft, revision/fingerprint and scoped action decision
writes: Authorized draft/version command result or a review-required card
rules: A matching existing grant can authorize the requested operation; otherwise the UI asks for review.
Saving a version is separately authorized and never executes it.
Missing saved IDs are explicit errors.

notes.summary: Provides worksheet explanations and source document search to Chat, including source revision and citation IDs in returned passages.
reads: Live worksheet intelligence, uploaded inputs, selected document and /api/documents/search
writes: Bounded cited search results or explicit empty/unavailable result for the model
rules: It does not fill missing source records with sample data.
Document passages are retrieved evidence; they do not grant operation authority.

notes.summary: Builds one idempotent computer request per user message, validates worker readiness and rejects a response bound to another chat, worker or request.
reads: Structured delegation, verified selected worker, current chat and user message
writes: Delegation POST via injected callback and bounded textual task context
rules: A changing chat does not silently resend accepted work.
Worker observations and local paths are not proof of platform success or uploaded sources.
Screenshots and raw permission arguments stay out of model context here.

notes.summary: Owns one workspace's save lifecycle with injected storage and transport, revision checks and protection from stale in-flight requests.
reads: Local library, sync revision/dirty state and remote portable library
writes: Revisioned remote saves, local sync metadata and visible status
rules: Failed writes remain dirty.
Revision conflicts stop automatic writes.
An older workspace request cannot overwrite the current workspace's status.

notes.summary: Binds portable session commands to Jotai and the browser graph runtime, sharing one run identity between Chat and Run.
reads: Saved workflow/template, session revision and current block readiness
writes: Workflow library session updates, active selection and block progression
rules: An explicit version is resolved exactly.
Opening Run changes selection; advanceSession performs block work.
Pause is observed between block calls; this loop still needs the browser.

notes.summary: Adapts saved definitions to browser execution, expanding legacy canvas defaults before calling the portable graph runner.
reads: Workflow definition and browser tool registry
writes: Calculation result from executeGraph
rules: Legacy normalization preserves original source timestamps.
Shared core does not import canvas or browser stores.
The adapter returns computation; it does not confirm a server save.

notes.summary: Owns workflow creation, draft replacement, immutable version saving, exact-version lookup and execution recording.
reads: Validated definitions, expected fingerprints, run options and injected executor
writes: New workflow entry, version snapshot or recorded run returned to caller
rules: An explicit missing version fails rather than selecting another.
Executors receive cloned saved definitions.
A reused request ID cannot execute a different version.

notes.summary: Orders the selected workflow graph and executes each block through injected tool lookup while collecting output, evidence and run records.
reads: Workflow graph, execution mode and injected GraphRuntime
writes: Block outputs, dependency/run status, messages and execution record
rules: Tool implementation comes through runtime injection.
Graph calculation does not imply human approval or database persistence.

notes.summary: Owns version-bound guided run state, source revisions, block execution, invalidation, pause/resume and document review annotation commands.
reads: Exact saved version, session revision, source/extraction or block action and GraphRuntime
writes: Updated session with recorded source changes, results and revision
rules: Stale session revisions fail.
Changed source data invalidates dependent results.
Document review notes require a paused run and are separate from calculation inputs.

notes.summary: Composes the common deterministic tool registry from modular block adapters and other owned tools.
reads: Tool definitions, backend-adapted IDs and explicit alias mapping
writes: Shared tool registry consumed by both browser and durable execution
rules: Missing modular executors fail during registry creation.
Registry composition rejects duplicate ownership.
The keyword-classifier compatibility name aliases the keyword mapper.

notes.summary: Validates portable workflow libraries and v0/v1 backup envelopes while preserving saved version and historical run provenance.
reads: Untrusted backup envelope and nested workflow library data
writes: Validated library or a clear rejection
rules: Unknown backup formats fail.
Missing/duplicate IDs and broken saved-version references fail.
Draft graphs may remain incomplete; restore does not silently repair execution.

notes.summary: Defines source identity and citation shapes, filters eligible passages and enforces lifecycle transitions independently of storage and UI.
reads: Candidate source passages, workspace/client scope, selected IDs, role and lifecycle action
writes: Selected cited passages or validated lifecycle target
rules: Only active sources in authorized scope are eligible.
Selected passages are prioritized while preserving revision/chunk citation identity.
Restore and purge require owner role under these rules.

notes.summary: Validates durable run requests, resolves the exact version from the workspace's stored library and rejects unavailable tools before enqueue.
reads: Authenticated scope, workflow/version/request ID and saved library bytes
writes: Queued immutable job response, run reads, cancellation or retry request
rules: It does not accept a browser-provided execution graph as the saved version.
Unknown tools fail before a job is created.
The request ID is checked for conflicting reuse.

notes.summary: Persists durable workflow jobs and owns idempotent enqueue, concurrent claims, completion, retry scheduling, cancellation and stalled-job recovery.
reads: Workspace scope, immutable definition, request ID and existing job state
writes: workflow_run_jobs rows, result/status and attempt/recovery fields
rules: Claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
Enqueue compares a repeated request with the original work.
Completion checks cancellation state before declaring success.

notes.summary: Runs a server-side graph using the same shared deterministic registry as browser execution.
reads: Saved workflow definition and durable run ID
writes: Graph result and execution record
rules: Unavailable tool IDs fail before execution.
The injected ID preserves the durable job/run relationship.
It replays pinned inputs; it does not refresh sources itself.

notes.summary: Polls the durable queue, recovers stalled jobs, executes claimed snapshots and writes completion or retry/failure state.
reads: Worker environment settings and claimed database jobs
writes: Job results/status, retry timing and structured logs
rules: It runs in the API process unless disabled/configured separately.
A thrown execution retries only within the job's attempt budget.
Browser closure does not stop an already queued server job.

notes.summary: Loads and saves one revisioned portable workflow library per authorized workspace and supports explicit legacy claims.
reads: Workspace scope, validated backup payload and expected revision
writes: workspace_libraries payload/revision and explicit legacy claim record
rules: A stale revision returns 409 and retains the newer saved copy.
Deletion keeps a revisioned empty library so stale writers cannot reuse revision zero.
Legacy claim is explicit and account-only.

notes.summary: Persists workspace-scoped conversation threads and messages with validated request shapes.
reads: Session-derived actor/workspace, thread ID and message batch
writes: chat_threads and chat_messages records
rules: Thread reads are constrained to the active workspace.
Conflicting thread identity cannot overwrite another workspace's thread.
Message content is stored data, not an authorization source.

notes.summary: Provides source listing, signed upload/download access, completion, search and lifecycle operations.
reads: Workspace-scoped document requests, object metadata and retrieval query
writes: Document metadata/lifecycle, queued ingestion and signed transfer responses
rules: Original file bytes live in private object storage.
Search uses workspace-filtered retrieval.
A successful upload and completed searchable ingestion are separate states.

notes.summary: Embeds a query, queries active source chunks in the workspace and converts eligible candidates into cited source passages.
reads: Query text, active workspace/client scope, selected document IDs and embedding configuration
writes: Search result with passages, source identity/revision and explicit limitations
rules: Missing embeddings produces unavailable rather than invented search results.
Both chunk and document rows are constrained by workspace.
Selected-only and selected-and-authorized policies are explicit.

notes.summary: Processes a queued original document into extracted text, chunks and searchable vectors using configured extraction/OCR/embedding services.
reads: Document metadata, private object bytes and configured extraction/embedding providers
writes: Document processing state, content hash and document_chunks rows
rules: Ingestion reports provider/storage failures distinctly.
Only actual extracted content is indexed.

notes.summary: Brokers private Supabase object storage with server credentials and short-lived signed upload/download URLs.
reads: Storage configuration and document object key
writes: Signed URLs, downloaded bytes or explicit object deletion
rules: The service-role key stays in the server adapter.
Missing configuration makes helpers fail clearly.
Signed uploads send bytes directly from browser to storage.

notes.summary: Creates a computer task bound to a saved workspace chat and personal worker, with transactional deduplication and readiness checks.
reads: Session-derived actor/workspace, thread, worker, request ID and structured objective
writes: mkoro conversation, task and outbound command records
rules: Changed worker/objective under the same request ID conflicts.
Revoked, offline or incompatible workers cannot accept a new task.
A worker already performing a task is rejected for a new delegation.

notes.summary: Exposes the companion-specific pairing, polling, event and screen-upload endpoints behind worker authentication.
reads: Pairing body or bearer worker token and validated worker payload
writes: Worker command responses, task events and optional ephemeral screen frame
rules: Worker authentication derives actor/workspace; the browser session path is separate.
Worker credentials are for this route family rather than native platform commands.

notes.summary: Implements the outbound companion HTTP client and worker protocol helpers used around local Goose task execution.
reads: Configured server origin, worker token and bounded protocol payload
writes: Authenticated /api/mkoro-worker requests and bounded textual tool summaries
rules: Requests reject redirects and have a timeout.
Public tool summaries omit raw inputs, resource contents and screenshots.
Goose uses its own configured local provider and tools.

notes.summary: Implements the separate server-side Agent Lab loop using AI SDK tools, stop conditions and model-routing policy.
reads: Selected model, prompts, documents, messages, tool settings and step cap
writes: Model response and tool execution results through the agent loop
rules: This is distinct from live Chat's CopilotKit route.
Gateway-prefixed model IDs use the gateway; bare IDs use gateway when configured, otherwise the OpenAI adapter.
Attached document context is bounded.

notes.summary: Creates the shared PostgreSQL pool and Drizzle database handle used by server routes and workers.
reads: DATABASE_URL and exported schema definitions
writes: Database client/pool handles; individual consumers own their queries
rules: Missing DATABASE_URL fails explicitly.
This module does not apply schema migrations.

journeys.title: Ask Chat to explain a source or figure
journeys.description: Use selected source evidence and recorded worksheet context to understand an answer.

steps.title: Select a source or workflow
steps.description: Attach/open the relevant source or saved workflow so the request has a concrete target.

steps.title: Retrieve permitted evidence
steps.description: The chat retrieval adapter calls /documents/search; the server filters active workspace sources and returns revisioned citations.

steps.title: Read citations and limits
steps.description: Inspect the returned source/revision and any unavailable passages. A missing source remains missing rather than being replaced by example data.

journeys.title: Ask AI to change a saved workflow
journeys.description: Draft edits and version creation are separate operations with domain validation and scoped authorization.

steps.title: Identify the exact saved workflow
steps.description: List saved workflows and read the chosen ID before proposing a complete revised draft.

steps.title: Authorize and review the proposal
steps.description: A matching scoped grant can authorize the operation; otherwise the chat shows a review card. Revision/fingerprint checks protect changed drafts.

steps.title: Save a version and synchronize
steps.description: The version command snapshots the validated graph. Library sync persists it with an expected server revision; saving does not execute it.

journeys.title: Work through a workflow in Chat or Run
journeys.description: Both surfaces use one saved-version session and the browser runtime.

steps.title: Open a version-bound session
steps.description: Create or reopen the selected workflow session and retain its exact run ID between surfaces.

steps.title: Attach source evidence
steps.description: Parse supplied records or document text and apply a source action with revision identity. Downstream results become outdated when their source changes.

steps.title: Execute ready blocks
steps.description: Advance the browser session through ready blocks; use Pause before later block calls. Keep the tab open for this execution path.

steps.title: Inspect and review
steps.description: Open recorded block outputs and evidence. A completed calculation remains separate from approval and server synchronization.

journeys.title: Run a saved version on the server
journeys.description: Use the durable queue when execution must outlive the initiating browser tab.

steps.title: Save and synchronize the exact version
steps.description: The API reads the version from the persisted workspace library; it does not trust an arbitrary graph sent with enqueue.

steps.title: Validate and enqueue
steps.description: POST /workflow-runs checks execute access, request shape, saved version and tool availability before creating an idempotent job.

steps.title: Compute with shared executors
steps.description: A worker claims the snapshot and executes the same deterministic registry, then records completion, retry or error state.

steps.title: Return to Workflows → run history
steps.description: Read the job result by its exact ID. Opening the historical record does not queue another execution or grant approval.

journeys.title: Delegate a computer step
journeys.description: Use a paired personal companion for work outside the native platform tools.

steps.title: Form the structured task
steps.description: Chat records the target, objective, expected output and why a platform tool cannot perform the step.

steps.title: Bind and admit the task
steps.description: The API verifies the saved chat, current actor/workspace, selected worker capability and heartbeat, and deduplicates the request.

steps.title: Poll and execute locally
steps.description: The companion dials out with a revocable worker token and runs Goose through ACP using the computer's configured tools and sessions.

steps.title: Inspect progress and decisions
steps.description: Chat shows events, Stop and one-action permission requests. A worker's completion text does not verify a TaxflowOS workflow or upload local files.
